title: Missing Templates in New+ Context Menu

judgment.rationale: The report identifies a real New+ menu gap, but it still does not say which templates are missing or whether they are being skipped because of folder structure or file attributes.
evidence: The issue says only some templates appear in the New+ context menu even after toggling the feature, changing the template location, and restarting File Explorer.
Current source in src/modules/NewPlus/NewShellExtensionContextMenu/template_folder.cpp rescans only the immediate contents of the configured template folder.
Current source in src/modules/NewPlus/NewShellExtensionContextMenu/helpers_variables.h excludes hidden and system items from the visible template list.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for the exact missing template names, their location/attributes, and a sample missing template so maintainers can distinguish an unsupported folder layout from a New+ enumeration bug.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys fix may be needed, but the current public report is not specific enough to choose between New+ template enumeration, hidden-item filtering, or template-folder layout handling.

issue_context.summary: The reporter says New+ shows only some templates from the configured template location, even after changing the location and restarting Explorer.
known_information: The issue is filed against PowerToys 0.100.2 after an auto-update.
The problem occurs in the New+ context menu rather than while creating the copied file itself.
The reporter already tried toggling New+, changing the template location, and restarting File Explorer.
inferences: The failure is likely in how New+ enumerates visible templates, not in template copy or rename behavior after selection.
The missing items may share a trait such as being nested, hidden, system-marked, or of a specific file type, but the current report does not identify that trait yet.
issue_context.analysis: This is specific enough to avoid a generic request for logs, because the current source already shows two concrete visibility boundaries: only top-level entries are scanned, and hidden/system items are excluded. The missing detail is which of the reporter’s templates fall into those buckets, so the best next step is a targeted evidence request about the missing template files and folder layout.
initial_investigation: src/modules/NewPlus/NewShellExtensionContextMenu/template_folder.cpp builds the menu from std::filesystem::directory_iterator(template_folder_path), which only enumerates immediate children of the configured template folder.
src/modules/NewPlus/NewShellExtensionContextMenu/helpers_variables.h returns true from exclude_item() for hidden or system files, so those entries are intentionally skipped.

information_gaps.information: A screenshot of the configured New+ template location in settings and the corresponding folder contents in Explorer.
information_gaps.why_needed: This shows whether the missing templates are direct children of the configured folder or live somewhere New+ does not enumerate.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Open the New+ settings page to show the configured template folder, then open that folder in Explorer and capture a screenshot of the visible contents.

information_gaps.information: The exact filenames and file types of one or two templates that should appear but do not, including whether they are files, folders, hidden, or system-marked.
information_gaps.why_needed: This distinguishes a New+ filtering rule from a broader failure to read the template folder.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the names/extensions of the missing templates and note whether any of them are marked Hidden or System in file properties.

information_gaps.information: A small sample of one missing template file, or confirmation that the missing item is a folder template rather than a file template.
information_gaps.why_needed: A concrete sample lets maintainers test whether a specific extension or template shape is being filtered out.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Attach one non-sensitive missing template file through GitHub, or state that the missing item is a folder template and not a file.

actions.label: Clarify missing New+ templates

comment.body:
Thanks for already confirming that toggling New+, changing the template location, and restarting Explorer did not help. To narrow this to the right New+ enumeration path, please provide:

1. A screenshot of the configured New+ template folder in settings and the contents of that folder in Explorer.
2. The exact filenames/extensions of one or two templates that should appear but do not, including whether they are files, folders, or marked Hidden/System.
3. If possible, attach one small missing template file, or confirm that the missing item is a folder template instead.

That will tell us whether New+ is skipping a specific template shape or whether the configured folder layout itself is outside the current scan path.
